claims: Multiple reports on March 20, 2026, stated that Chuck Norris died at the age of 86.
The family confirmed Chuck Norris's sudden passing following a recent hospitalization in Hawaii.
Reports noted that Chuck Norris had been in good spirits despite the hospitalization.
Reports noted that Chuck Norris was training just days before his death.
Chuck Norris recently celebrated his 86th birthday.
Chuck Norris had roles in Walker, Texas Ranger, The Delta Force, and Missing in Action.
There have been many hoax stories about Chuck Norris's death over the years.
Reports on March 20, 2026, confirmed Chuck Norris's passing
